title: Mass lower bound for locally finite Dirac sums
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and U, W, N ⊆ ℝ^P = Eucl P with W open and W ⊆ U. Let Y ∈ D_0(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U 0) and c : ℝ^P → ℤ. Assume N ∩ K is finite for every compact K ⊆ U, and Y(ω) = ∑ᶠ_{x∈N} c(x)·ω(x)(![]) for every ω ∈ D⁰(U) (TestFormOn U 0). Then every finite set S (a Finset) with S ⊆ N ∩ W satisfies ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{x∈S} |c(x)|) ≤ M_W(Y) = Y.massOn W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U W N : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (c : Eucl P → ℤ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (N ∩ K).Finite) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, Y ω = ∑ᶠ x ∈ N, (c x : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) x ![]) → ∀ S : Finset (Eucl P), (↑S : Set (Eucl P)) ⊆ N ∩ W → ENNReal.ofReal (∑ x ∈ S, |(c x : ℝ)|) ≤ Y.massOn W
